performance_case.causal_mechanism: One canonical top-level dispatch command rejects drift and binding errors before Local execution while removing ad hoc invocation differences between Manager task handoffs.
performance_case.claim_boundary: This dispatch can prove only the two-file CLI surface, delegation to existing validators, deterministic output and offline fail-closed tests. Runtime productivity, Linux execution, evidence quality, PnL and drawdown remain MISSING_PROOF.
performance_case.drawdown_hypothesis: Immediate drawdown effect is zero because the command validates offline research envelopes only and cannot register, execute or promote a trading candidate.
performance_case.opportunity_cost: A narrow CLI closure avoids spending future Manager and Local cycles on preventable dispatch syntax or task/result binding mistakes while preserving the already reviewed validator as the single semantic authority.
performance_case.performance_hypothesis: Immediate fee-adjusted PnL effect is zero; infrastructure value is shorter and more reliable research-task startup so useful mechanisms can be accepted or rejected with less orchestration overhead.
